The likely fault is in [simple_cache.go](/app/utils/cache/simple_cache.go:10). The wrapper has no eviction sweep or `evictionDeadline`, `Keys` delegates directly to the underlying cache, and `Values` is absent. `Add`, `AddWithTTL`, `Get`, and `GetWithLoader` do not trigger eviction; the loader callback also inserts through `t.Set`, bypassing the wrapper’s add path.

[play_tracker.go](/app/core/scrobbler/play_tracker.go:109) depends on `Keys` to enumerate current players. The existing [cache tests](/app/utils/cache/simple_cache_test.go:1) pass, but they check expiry through `Get`, not expired `Keys` or `Values`. Underlying `ttlcache` enumeration behavior remains an uncertainty because this inspection was limited to repository code.

A fix should sweep expired entries during the listed operations, include loader insertion, and make `Keys` and `Values` expose only active entries after short TTLs such as 10 ms. It should preserve capacity eviction and loader supplied TTLs and values. **No project source or tests were changed** under the fault localization assignment. The progress note is in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md).

Implemented opportunistic eviction in `SimpleCache` using an atomic deadline based on the earliest known expiry. `Add`, `AddWithTTL`, `Get`, `GetWithLoader`, `Keys`, and the new `Values` method now trigger eviction; `Keys` and `Values` expose only active entries. Loader inserts retain their supplied values and TTLs.

Added tests for 10 ms expiry, loader values, and capacity after an item expires. `go test ./utils/cache`, `go test -race ./utils/cache`, and `go test ./core/scrobbler` all pass.

VERDICT: FIX

**Code defect:** [simple_cache.go](/app/utils/cache/simple_cache.go:71) clears `evictionDeadline` before deleting expired entries. A concurrent `AddWithTTL` can then skip eviction and insert into a full cache while an expired entry still occupies capacity, potentially evicting an active entry. Keep the sweep synchronized with insertion, or keep a due deadline visible until deletion finishes.

**Tests run:** `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./utils/cache -count=1`, `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test -race ./utils/cache -count=1`, and `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./core/scrobbler -count=1` all passed. The interleaving above is not covered by those tests. No `TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM`.

Fixed the eviction race in [simple_cache.go](/app/utils/cache/simple_cache.go). Expiration sweeps and insertions, including loader insertions, now share a lock, so an expired entry cannot occupy capacity while a concurrent add evicts an active entry.

All three tests flagged by the reviewer passed: the cache tests, cache race tests, and scrobbler tests.
